# Build Your Own Dataset

This page will help a reader choose how to get the dataset they need: query the published Parquet tables, build tables from a bundle, or cut a mini-bundle for a subset of ClinVar. Until it is written, see [Build Your Own Tables and Mini-Bundles](../parquet/build-your-own.md) and [Recipes](../parquet/recipes.md).
